title: Neoh Gaussian-Splat Reconstruction
description: Turn 8+ overlapping property photos into a walkable 3D Gaussian splat (.splat). COLMAP poses + nerfstudio splatfacto (Apache-2.0) + PlayCanvas splat-transform (MIT). Uses presigned S3 HTTPS URLs, so the worker never receives AWS credentials. All-commercial-OK licensing (no DUSt3R / INRIA-3DGS).

input.name: Training iterations
input.description: splatfacto iterations — quality vs. cost. 7000 is a good default for a house.
